name: Jun Ash
seed: Mender and sign painter. Mara values Jun’s care; perfectionism delays useful work. Home: West Lantern.
design: Field mouse, tan fur, indigo vest, ochre paint-stained cuffs and a square brush case.
history: A Millmere sign painter who wanted more room for personal work; arrived four years ago and shares West Lantern routines with Mara.
desire: To paint a mural that belongs to its neighbors rather than his reputation.
contradiction: Keeps improving a useful object until nobody gets to use it.
relationships: Mara feeds him during long jobs; Neri tests his signs; Tavi trades repairs.
arc: Releases a good-enough first version, watches people use it and improves it from observation.
story_engine: A mural vote exposes an old disagreement; an urgent banner must work without words.
writer_truth: His neatest signature covers an old spelling error he has never confessed.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
